cases.name: consolidate-near-duplicates-preserving-metadata
cases.trap: Without the skill, a model tends to send reflect with a fresh 'tags' array (wiping oncall-p1/recovery) or omit related_memory_ids handling, rewrite content generically and drop B's ext4-only limit and NFS negative result, skip the revision guard, or forget B before the survivor is confirmed.
expectations: Updates A (or one survivor) with content that keeps both the ext4-only verification limit and the NFS rename failure/issue #412 as well as A's regression test pointer
Preserves A's existing tags and related_memory_ids (uses add_tags or a deliberately merged full array, not a replacement that drops them)
Includes expected_revision 7 (the revision just read) on the reflect call
Verifies the survivor's stored content (e.g. memories get by id) before calling forget on the other record
Uses full UUIDs and the memory_id field for reflect/forget, and id for memories get
negative_expectations: Calls forget before the survivor update is confirmed
Sends a tags array that omits 'oncall-p1' or 'recovery'
States the lesson as applying to all filesystems
Mentions purging trash or permanent deletion

cases.name: distil-one-lesson-from-session
cases.prompt: Session wrap-up for project 'ledger' (Synabun connected; remember requires project and category; existing categories: engineering-lessons, decisions). Today 2026-11-11 we: renamed three helpers; bumped lint config; merged PR #301 after review; spent 5 hours on a flaky test that turned out to be time-zone dependent: TestMonthClose passed in UTC CI but failed locally in Europe/Oslo because month boundaries were computed with time.Local; switching to an explicit UTC location fixed it, and the test now fails when TZ=Europe/Oslo is forced and the fix is reverted (commit 9c1e2fa). We also suspect, but did not test, that the same pattern exists in the reporting service. Do whatever memory work is appropriate and show the calls.
cases.trap: Models without the skill tend to save a session journal (renames, lint, PR merged, hours spent), or several memories, or record the untested reporting-service suspicion as fact.
expectations: Searches for an existing equivalent lesson before writing
Writes at most one memory, about the time.Local month-boundary failure, in project ledger with an existing category
Content includes symptom, cause, fix, evidence pointer (commit 9c1e2fa or TestMonthClose) and observation date
Labels the reporting-service occurrence as an untested suspicion, if mentioned at all
negative_expectations: Creates memories for helper renames, lint bump, or PR #301 status
States as fact that the reporting service has the bug
Justifies importance by the 5 hours spent
